programme.title: Braveheart

programme.title: Paranormal Activity: The Ghost Dimension

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: It is Christmas Eve and the Harringtons take a trip to their in-laws to celebrate the holidays. Taking an unfamiliar shortcut, Mr. Harrington makes the biggest mistake of his life and leads his family down a terror-filled road with no end.

programme.title: Winnie-the-Pooh: Blood and Honey

programme.title: Get Rich or Die Tryin'

programme.title: Juice

programme.title: Paid in Full

programme.title: Legionnaire

programme.title: The Order
programme.desc: Martial arts icon Jean-Claude Van Damme stars as a playboy criminal thrust into a dangerous world of ancient evil when he must investigate the disappearance of his archaeologist father. With Oscar winner Charlton Heston and Sofia Milos.

programme.title: Derailed

programme.title: Tropic Thunder

programme.title: School of Rock

programme.title: Little Nicky

programme.title: Titanic

programme.title: Chicago

programme.title: The English Patient

programme.title: Patriot Games
